note:
Per-fixture allowlist of EXPECTED layout-diff check failures (lib/expected-failures.mjs). A listed failure does not make layout-diff/run.mjs exit 2 and does not fail the gate. The expiry is enforced: when a listed check passes, run.mjs exits 2 and the gate fails with 'allowlist entry expired' until the entry is removed. Adding an entry needs a reason with evidence and an expiry condition; it never hides an input-parity failure that invalidates attribution without saying so (attribution_valid stays false and Chrome-referenced verdicts keep their caveat). entries.reason: the template's first line is an XHTML 1.0 Transitional doctype; blitz-html 0.3.0-beta.4 (src/html_sink.rs lines 92-99, read 2026-10-21) then parses the source with its XML parser, which inserts no implied <tbody>. Blitz's source parse has table>tr while Chromium (page.setContent = HTML parser) has table>tbody>tr, so element keys differ (4 common, 91 only in vellora, 102 only in Chromium). CONFIRMED (source read + check detail). This is a real input-handling difference of vellora, not a harness artefact.
